    if pos.y < 11.7:

        if vy > 0:
            # Moving up, apply upward force
            sandbox.apply_force_to_seat(0, 42.0)
        else:

            sandbox.apply_force_to_seat(0, -42.0)

    if pos.y >= 11.7:

        else:

            sandbox.apply_force_to_seat(-vx * 10.0, 0)
